DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>: Each top-level JSON key is an AutomationLoader group/job and the Python module filename, including .py. Use the normal AutomationLoader group selection to choose a module or all configured groups. Each group independently requires ModuleFolder (string), CheckFolders (list), and CheckFiles (list).
DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>.ModuleFolder: Directory containing the target Python module.
DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>.CheckFolders: Folders recursively scanned when checking where functions from the selected module are used.
DESCRIPTION.<GROUP>.CheckFiles: Individual Python files additionally scanned when checking function usage.
